title: Count Subarrays With Maximum Value
description: Let `M` be the largest value anywhere in `nums`. Count non-empty contiguous subarrays whose bitwise AND equals `M`. Input: a non-negative integer array `nums`. Output: the number of such subarrays.
hints: Keep a running total or frequency count rather than recomputing over all prefixes.
Test repeated values, zeros, and minimum-size inputs.
